findings.summary: Stripe-to-NMI-to-Radom payment rail evolution (Jul 2022 - Dec 2025) tracks legal exposure: each transition follows a major enforcement or platform action
findings.detail: Payment rail chronology: (1) Pre-Jul 2022: Stripe via nominee account holder 'J' (~M credited per CCDC judgment); (2) Jul 2022: Stripe terminates Hustlers University relationship; (3) Aug 2022: 50% affiliate programme activated to drive signups during payment transition; (4) Jan 2023: NMI payment gateway confirmed at nmi.therealworld.ag (within weeks of arrest); (5) Apr 2021 - Jan 2023: Radom Pay Polish VASP entity built in parallel; (6) Jul 2023: Radom Pay UK entity incorporated; (7) Mar 2024: Radom rebrands radom.network → radom.com (coincides with UK extradition warrant); (8) Dec 2025: Radom Pay confirmed primary TRW checkout; M+ in Railgun privacy protocol flows identified by on-chain analyst. Each payment rail transition follows a legal or platform enforcement action by 30-90 days. The Railgun flows (M+) represent a qualitative escalation beyond processor-substitution into privacy-layer obfuscation.

findings.summary: Pre-Meta-ban preparation window (Aug 17-22, 2022): UK name-squatting shell incorporated 5 days before ban; Romanian operating entity transferred to Dubai FZCO on ban day itself
findings.detail: Andrew Tate Limited (CH 14301925) incorporated Aug 17 2022 — exactly 5 days before the Aug 22 2022 Meta deplatforming. On Aug 22 (ban day) Tate brothers executed share transfer of Emory Andrew Tate and Sons SRL to Posillipo Enterprises FZCO (Dubai Silicon Oasis), placing the primary Romanian entity behind UAE free-zone ownership. Legendary Courses Inc. (Wyoming) incorporated Aug 24 — 2 days post-ban. 50% affiliate programme activated Aug 20. The 7-day window (Aug 17-24, 9 findings) is the densest single-week corporate action cluster in the investigation. The UK shell was never traded and compulsorily dissolved Jan 2024 with zero statutory filings — consistent with name-squatting not operational intent. Innocent explanation: rapid reactive asset protection after an unexpected platform decision. Coordination signal: Romanian transfer on the same calendar day as ban suggests either foreknowledge or pre-drafted paperwork.

findings.summary: Post-arrest infrastructure pivot window (Dec 29, 2022 - Jan 4, 2023): 14 findings in 6-day window; Antigua TLD, NMI integration, and Radom Pay Polish licensing all cluster immediately after Romanian arrest
findings.detail: Within 6 days of the Dec 29 2022 Romanian arrest: (1) War Room and TRW migrated to .ag (Antigua & Barbuda) TLDs by Jan 1 — moving operational surfaces out of .com jurisdiction; (2) NMI payment gateway confirmed active at nmi.therealworld.ag by Jan 4; (3) Radom Pay's Polish VASP entity (KRS 0001079663) established with payment license dated Jan 2023; (4) Ground Breaking Development SRL filed its last ANAF tax return on Jan 4 2023 — Romanian tax trail goes dark immediately; (5) 21 Studios LLC dissolved Jan 3; (6) PBD publicly framed the arrest as political persecution Jan 1. The speed of migration (operational platforms on .ag TLDs within 3 days of arrest) implies pre-staged infrastructure rather than improvised response.

findings.summary: DIICOT formal indictment (Jun 20, 2023) preceded 8 days earlier by PBD media rehabilitation visit to Romania (Jun 12) — promotional interviews bracketed by legal milestones
findings.detail: Patrick Bet-David's Valuetainment podcast team physically traveled to Romania to conduct multi-part interviews with both Andrew Tate (separately with Tristan) starting Jun 12 2023 — 8 days before DIICOT formally indicted all four defendants on Jun 20 2023. The interviews aired as sympathetic long-form content characterizing Tate as a persecuted strong man. A second PBD team Romania visit in June 2023 bracketed the indictment. PBD's Jan 1 2023 framing ('warning shot to strong men') established the narrative template that the Jun 2023 interviews amplified. Pattern: major legal milestones are preceded or immediately followed by friendly long-form media that reinforces alternative framing. The PBD visits serve as the primary US-audience counter-narrative vehicle at each legal crisis point (arrests Dec 2022, indictment Jun 2023, Florida arrival Mar 2025).

findings.summary: Radom Pay UK incorporated (Jul 31, 2023) within 4 days of Tate witness-intimidation lawsuit filing (Jul 11), 6 months after NMI adoption post-arrest — payment rail buildout tracks legal exposure milestones
findings.detail: Radom Pay Limited (UK, 15038466) incorporated July 31 2023. This falls: (1) 20 days after Tate v. Doe filed in Palm Beach state court Jul 11 (witness-intimidation litigation); (2) 7 months after Stripe termination (Jul 2022); (3) 7 months after NMI adoption (Jan 2023). The Radom Pay UK entity complements the Polish VASP (licensed Jan 2023) to create a two-jurisdiction crypto-capable payment rail. Radom Pay then rebranded radom.network → radom.com in March 2024 — coinciding with the UK extradition warrant (Mar 1 2024) and Bucharest CoA extradition approval (Mar 12). By Dec 2025 pay.radom.com is the confirmed primary TRW checkout with M+ in Railgun flows. The payment rail construction timeline maps cleanly onto escalating legal exposure: Stripe termination → NMI → Radom UK entity → Radom rebrand → Railgun flows.

findings.summary: Radom Pay co-founder resignations (Nov 6, 2024) followed DIICOT Case 2 raids by 77 days and preceded UK Case 1 collapse by 43 days — key personnel exit brackets maximum legal pressure
findings.detail: Two of four original Radom Pay Limited UK co-founders resigned their directorships on Nov 6 2024. Contextually: DIICOT Case 2 raids occurred Aug 21 2024 (77 days before); Bucharest CoA identified Case 1 indictment defects Nov 19 2024 (13 days after); UK forfeiture order Dec 18 (42 days after); Romanian case returned Dec 19 (43 days after). The co-founder exits align exactly with maximum legal pressure on the associated payment infrastructure. Innocent explanation: normal business attrition. Concerning signal: two simultaneous co-founder exits at Radom Pay's most legally exposed moment — 77 days after the raids on the entity's primary client.

findings.summary: UK Account Forfeiture Orders (Dec 18, 2024) and Romanian Case 1 return to DIICOT (Dec 19, 2024) occurred on consecutive days — cross-jurisdictional legal pressure maximum at year-end 2024
findings.detail: Westminster Magistrates' Court granted Account Forfeiture Orders totalling £2.68M+ on Dec 18 2024 (CCDC v TTJ judgment). One day later — Dec 19 2024 — the Bucharest Court of Appeal returned Case 1 to DIICOT for full reinvestigation after identifying three indictment defects. These two events from opposite jurisdictions (UK enforcement success; Romanian case partial collapse) on consecutive days represent the highest single-week legal density in the investigation. The Romanian case return, while framed as a setback for prosecutors, ultimately extended DIICOT authority to reinvestigate with improved forensics. Within 10 weeks of this dual-jurisdiction event, Tates departed Romania to Florida (Feb 27 2025).

findings.summary: Florida migration window (Feb 27 - Mar 22, 2025): 24-day stay generated 6 findings including new lawsuit, DHS/FL AG investigation, PBD interview, and crypto activity — coordinated US-facing response after Romanian case collapse
findings.detail: Tate brothers arrived Fort Lauderdale Feb 27 2025, returned Romania Mar 22 — 24 days. During this window: (1) Florida AG + DHS initiated new criminal investigations (Mar 1); (2) Crypto meme coin activity (Solana, pump-dump pattern) noted as active (Mar 1 context); (3) PBD Podcast Ep. 555 recorded in Florida Mar 3 (third Tate-PBD interview, establishing US political/legal narrative); (4) New Palm Beach lawsuit 50-2025-CA-002559 filed Mar 18 against social media defendants. The 24-day Florida window appears to serve multiple simultaneous functions: establish US legal presence, generate sympathetic media, file new litigation, and activate crypto monetization. UK extradition is approved in principle; Romanian case in flux — Florida provides neutral jurisdiction for media and legal maneuvering.
